title: Design a merge flow after Anthropic's: lanes merge on own green checks, main bisects and reverts, sessions install from a stable branch
why: Batch CI holds every merge behind one run; the owner is open to a radical redesign. Home #728 MERGED 05:18 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 05:19, ls-remote and REST 05:18, merged_at 11:17:29Z; relayed, not re-read by triage): main 0ce1da563431, the first per-lane merge in home. The plan's row (1) done check was "first per-lane merge on home with stable"; whether the merge ran with the stable install is unread, so this step is not marked done. Home main push run 43589317298 queued; runner 11 reads it before the next home merge. Next in home: #730 (head 356a04c6, merge-tree clean, no record yet, round-1 reviewer started by runner 11).
note: R42 part 2 (owner 13:39 CST Nov 11, "i'm pretty open to this radical approach -- A", relayed by the retrospective; plan 7a78c5c). In stage 3 a Plan agent and a refuter design the flow after the post "Redesigning source control at Anthropic" (Oct 13): a lane merges on its own green checks and a review sized by risk; main's CI runs after merge, and a red run bisects and reverts the breaking commit; sessions install from a stable branch that moves only when main is green. The design goes back to the owner before any build. Needs main to finish a CI run first (#2591). Once the design is ruled, it would retire rule git-no-merge-during-batch-ci. Design (Plan agent plus refuter, holds with changes, 22:58 CST Nov 11): docs/plans/r42-part2-design.md on branch claude/ecstatic-euler-capib9, commit 402613631. It lands on main in the next prose batch no owner wait (page items 522-525 never existed on the page; the owner approved the design in item 543 and 544, both closed, Nov 12) (group r42-part2-design, owner coordinator). Design questions settled with no owner ask (coordinator 23:04 CST Nov 11): (1) child repos switch together, each with its stable branch and revert route first, by decision uniform-over-variants (owner 2026-10-27 12:51 CDT); (2) the batch runner merges each lane PR, never the lane, by decision standing-merge-grant (owner 2026-11-01 19:23 CST); draft-until-reviewed lifts in the same merge as the switch, by the owner's 13:43 CST Nov 11 R42 part 2 pick A, after one narrow lane PR run's CI minutes are measured and recorded in the design; (3) a red main halts merges and the revert starts at once, by R26 item 3 and decision no-merge-onto-red-main; (4) a revert is an ordinary lane PR under --base-red-ok, coordinator pick, undoable; (5) the name "batch runner" stays, coordinator pick, undoable. Design home: docs/plans/r42-part2-design.md, commit 402613631 on branch claude/ecstatic-euler-capib9; it lands on main in the next prose batch. Plan R55 (owner 13:19 and 13:21 CST Nov 12, restart-plan 4fefc9f, pick d: "Express lane, and cancel a running batch for it too"): a reviewed merge-flow lane goes to main as its own batch, ahead of all others; the batch runner cancels a batch run already in CI, and that batch then merges main in. Home: decision no-merge-during-batch-ci; skill ci-hygiene step 8 points to it (retrospective 13:23 CST, plan b152ca6). The owner chose this over the one-batch-in-turn rule.
